items.item_text: Experience setting up and operating radiographic equipment to produce diagnostic films for companion exotic species.
Experience placing and maintaining intravascular and urinary catheters for companion exotic species.
Experience obtaining a wide variety of diagnostic samples and providing therapeutic treatments to companion exotic species.

Independent of direct supervision, provide multi-disciplinary veterinary technical support for the Companion Exotic Pet (CAPE) Service of the VMTH. Work with Companion exotic species of animals including birds, reptiles, exotic small mammals, wildlife, aquatic and zoo animals. Provide nursing and anesthesia technical support. Set-up, teach and perform medical treatments per clinician orders. Under general direction of the CAPE Supervisor, facilitate clinical teaching activities, patient care and client service within the CAPE service. Maintain and clean all service areas. Quasi-instructor to veterinary students on techniques, policy and procedures.
